wrong_claims: Section 4 (Unique_Review_Key__c) and Section 6 (Bypass): 'no FLS grant ... administrators see it through Modify All Data' / 'only administrators can' blank the key. Modify All Data does not override field-level security; with no FLS grant (FieldPermissions on Review__c show no profile rows at all) no administrator can see or edit the field.

defects.defect: States that administrators see/edit Review__c.Unique_Review_Key__c through Modify All Data despite no FLS grant; wrong platform behavior presented as fact.
defects.skill_gap: v27 reference/org-verification.md FieldPermissions note itself says users with Modify All Data or View All Data still see the field (wrong; corrected in v29.1). The skill caused this defect.

defects.defect: Open decision 4 backfills Unique_Review_Key__c as a data step, but the design grants no FLS on the field to anyone, so the loading user (even System Administrator) cannot write it via Data Loader/API; the spec does not list the temporary FLS grant the backfill needs.
defects.skill_gap: None specific; a design-rules check that every data step names the access the loading user needs would prevent it.
